description:
Face to face is preferred.
 1. J2EE
 2. Spring / Hibernate
 3. JMS / MQ / SOAP Web Services - must have heavy experience working with messaging and API's
 4. Airline - previous background in the airline industry 
 American Airlines, Maintenance and Engineering will be looking for 5 Sr. Java Developers to help with their upcoming initiatives. Resources will be working on two major projects, SAFE (system agnostic front end) and Automated Pre Draw. Both applications interface with 6-8 other applications within American so heavy experience with different messaging tools is required. SAFE and Automated Pre Draw will be pulling info from FOS and SAP very heavily. The SAP system will be phased out over the coming months so resources will be adding the functionality of SAP to SAFE and APD now for when SAP is gone. It will be key for individuals to have a background in the airline industry due to the immense amount of integration points with other systems.

 Airline experience of 1+ years is a must. Ideally they have 2-4 years.
 


 GOOD COMMUNICATION SKILLS 
 
 6 Months Contract  
 
 Only H1B  GC or USCs
